review_report.json.verdict_basis: The registered content is real and honest — hash identity holds, all 31 char-span locators resolve byte-exactly, every count survives a recount, the five figure endpoints genuinely 404, the regulatory layer is not upgraded, and the reviewed report's arithmetic (TtW, GWP100, slip crossover, energy/fuel/CO2 triangle) survives independent recomputation. But the package's own gate is unsound exactly where it matters: verify() skips the six locators it does not understand yet reports 'checked 37 locators ... unresolvable=[]' with all_pass=true, and five figure-metadata assets carry markdown char spans for captions that are not in the markdown (F1/F2). A registration whose locators cannot be resolved by the documented rule is a traceability defect, not a cosmetic one, so the disposition is request-changes.

findings.title: 5/37 assets carry markdown char spans for figure captions that are not in the markdown
findings.description: A02–A06 (figure_platform_metadata) declare locator.scheme='report_field', field='figures', index=i, and *also* start_char=0 / end_char=10530. Their quote is the platform caption (record.figures[i].caption), which occurs 0 times in the report markdown. Under the rule the manifest itself states — md[start:end]==quote with count==1 — these five locators resolve to the whole report, not to the asset; a consumer applying the declared rule slices 10530 characters of unrelated text. `unique: true` / `verified: true` are asserted with no referent in the declared field.
findings.impact: 13.5% of the registered assets cannot be evidence-resolved by any downstream consumer that implements the documented resolution rule; the failure is silent because the metadata (name+caption) is genuinely present in record.figures[].
findings.remediation: Drop start_char/end_char for field='figures' locators (they are not char spans), add caption_sha256 + index as the resolution key, and set unique/verified to null or a scheme-specific value. Keep byte-span locators only for scheme='char_span'.

findings.title: verification.json reports 'checked 37 locators ... unresolvable=[]' but verify() span-tests only 31
findings.description: Replaying the upstream verify() locator branch reproduces its verdict (bad=[]), because the branch `continue`s before the span test for field='markdown' and field='figures'. Of 37 assets, 31 are span-tested and 6 are skipped, yet the envelope detail reads 'checked 37 locators against source_6537.md; unresolvable=[]' and all_pass=true. The manifest integrity sentence 'all locators verified md[start:end]==quote and md.count(quote)==1 at build time' is likewise false: 31/37 satisfy it.
findings.impact: The gate that is supposed to make the manifest trustworthy reports 'all pass' while a sixth of the locators were never tested. Anything downstream that trusts verification.all_pass inherits an unverified claim.
findings.remediation: Deny by default: any locator shape verify() does not understand is a failure, not a skip. Report the denominator per scheme (char_span 31/31, figures 5/5 by caption hash, document 1/1). Re-emit verification.json with the corrected detail string.

findings.title: Manifest declares asset_manifest.v1 but fails the repo-canonical schema in 72 places
findings.description: Against schemas/asset_manifest.v1.schema.json the manifest raises 72 validator errors, dominated by (a) missing top-level 'source' (it uses 'provenance'), and (b) asset.resolution.status values outside the canonical enum {resolved_in_source, referenced_unresolved, declared_absent}. This is not repo-wide drift: 48 of 69 manifests declaring asset_manifest.v1 validate clean. verify()'s schema_pass is self-defined (missing_top + missing_provenance only), so the non-conformance never surfaces.
findings.impact: A downstream consumer that validates against the canonical schema rejects the package; one that does not inherits a hand-rolled schema check.
findings.remediation: Either (i) align the manifest to the canonical schema (rename provenance->source, map the status vocabulary), or (ii) extend the canonical schema with the report_field locator shape and the resolved/metadata_only/unresolved/declared_unavailable vocabulary, and say which schema the package claims.

findings.title: A01 mixes method=document with a whole-document span and a single-line quote
findings.description: A01 (report_markdown) declares start_char=0 / end_char=10530 (the whole document) but quote = the first line only, so md[start:end] != quote. For a document-level asset this is defensible; it is, however, the reason the blanket integrity sentence cannot be literally true, and it is invisible because verify() skips field='markdown'.
findings.impact: Cosmetic for consumers that special-case documents; misleading for a generic resolver.
findings.remediation: Add an explicit locator field (e.g. identity_line) for the quote, or scope the integrity sentence to scheme='char_span' and state the other schemes' own resolution rules.

findings.title: Reviewed report's 加和残差 claim (max residual 0.0e+00 over 24 combos) is not checkable at print precision
findings.description: Recomputing WtW = WtT + TtW from the printed §1 table gives residual 0 for 10 rows and 0.01 gCO2e/MJ for fame and nh3_green. This does not falsify the claim (the underlying full-precision values are presumably exact), but a reviewer can only see two decimals.

evidence.quote_from_source: 最大残差 0.0e+00（24 个燃料×口径组合）

findings.impact: Zero at the level of the claim; a print-precision artefact that invites an avoidable challenge.
findings.remediation: State the residual at the printed precision ('<= 0.01 gCO2e/MJ, print rounding') or print three decimals for the sum columns.
